news.title: Sources: Peralta arranged Soto-Lindor meeting
news.summary: Multiple sources told ESPN that former Mets pitcher Freddy Peralta in June arranged for franchise cornerstones Juan Soto and Francisco Lindor to vent and work through their disconnected relationship.

news.title: Pirates release struggling DH Ozuna, call up Simon
news.summary: Veteran designated hitter Marcell Ozuna, who is hitting just .203 with eight home runs, has been released by the Pirates.

news.title: Gausman happy to be with Cubs, to start Friday
news.summary: Kevin Gausman, who is expected to make his Cubs debut on Friday, said he is happy to be in Chicago.

news.title: PCA states MVP case as he, Ohtani wow Wrigley
news.summary: Pete Crow-Armstrong emerged as the favorite to win NL MVP on Wednesday after slugging two home runs in a win against the Dodgers that saw their star, Shohei Ohtani, also go deep twice.

news.title: Scuffling Ryan returning to Minnesota for tests
news.summary: Twins ace Joe Ryan is returning to Minnesota to be evaluated for a potential injury after he was hit hard in a loss to the Kansas City Royals on Tuesday.

news.title: Reds' Greene returns to IL with elbow soreness
news.summary: Reds right-hander Hunter Greene, who has made only five starts since coming off the injured list, was put on the 15-day IL because of right elbow soreness.
